mechanism_analysis_block_reasons: Beauty Coefficient threshold is not validated for this source
methodological_findings: Robust SB identity must be separated from cohort-relative early/late quadrants; all three literature-reference cases passed the robust gate despite high relative early percentiles in sparse historical cohorts.
Case enrichment solved the zero-case problem seen in random 100- and 497-paper cohorts.
A small random control pool can achieve 100% match yield while remaining badly imbalanced, so match yield alone is not sufficient.
The two additional robust cases are discovery candidates only until cross-source validation and source-specific B calibration.
next_gate: Expand and optimize same-year/same-field control pools, then validate robust cases and B calibration in SciSciNet-v2 before substantive mechanism inference.
